pyridium.options.rayReconstruction.toolt: AI reconstruction on Tensor Cores. Off: native-resolution CUDA post-processing, no RR. Explicit JVM image modes remain selected.
pyridium.options.rayEffects.tooltip: Ray-traced direct shadows, reflections and water/glass refraction. Off: direct PBR lighting and simple water/glass surfaces. Primary visibility is still required.
pyridium.options.pathTracing.tooltip: Indirect diffuse light paths (GI). Off: no GI/AO rays or GI pass. Direct lighting remains active.
pyridium.options.hardwareRaytracing.tool: Hardware-accelerated ray traversal. Off: CUDA software traversal, no OptiX. Can be much slower at long view distances! Changing this rebuilds world/material caches.
pyridium.options.spectatorCache.tooltip: Builds loaded interiors/caves as an additional background HashDAG, with a bounded budget when VRAM is available. Off: build on demand in spectator mode.
